Description: Late game is driven by procedural galaxy exploration, rare discoveries, collection completion, and trading.
Every planet is generated from a unique seed. No two planets should feel exactly identical.
Players launch colony ships and expeditions to discover planets, resources, species, ruins, relics, and rare modifiers.
Collectibles become the long-term retention system after Future Core and planet colonization.
Ultra-rare collectibles create player-driven value through direct trades, auctions, duplicates, and collection completion.
Players display discoveries in museum wings, complete sets, and earn permanent bonuses.
Harmony Ascendant is earned through civilization mastery, exploration mastery, museum completion, and the Harmony Spire.
Discovery is a permanent progression statistic earned from exploration and cataloging the galaxy.
